snippet.title: FuryDough - roguelite about crazy donuts
snippet.description:
Play Free Demo and Wishlist FuryDough: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2350880/FuryDough/
Join FuryDough Discord server: https://discord.gg/wKgNVn4vNs 

Welcome to the wacky FuryDough world, where the real villains are... wait for it... CRAZY DONUTS!

Gear up for:
- The chaos of uniquely delicious procedurally generated levels
- A Donut Demolisher Arsenal
- Endless batches of crazed fights
